source.title: e-seimas: Lietuvos Respublikos gyventojų pajamų mokesčio įstatymas Nr. IX-1007, suvestinė redakcija nuo 2026-06-11 iki 2026-12-31, 6 straipsnio 1 dalis; Seimas: Valstybės socialinių fondų biudžetų 2026 metų rodiklių patvirtinimo įstatymas Nr. XV-632, 4 straipsnis

sections.basis: Annual income from employment and other income taxed on the general scale (after the NPD and allowable deductions), residents
sections.note: Thresholds are 36 and 60 times the 2026 average wage (VDU) of €2,312.15 used for the social insurance base. The middle 25% band is new for 2026.

Non-employment income up to 12 VDU (€27,745.80) a year, e.g. rent, interest, capital gains
rows.note: Above this amount the general scale applies

sections.note: Income taxed at the 15% non-employment rate and individual-activity income are counted first when the annual 20/25/32% bands are applied (GPM art. 6(11)).

sections.title: Tax-exempt amount (NPD) 2026

rows.label: Maximum monthly NPD (monthly employment income up to the minimum monthly wage)
Monthly formula
rows.value: NPD = €747 − 0.49 × (monthly employment income − the minimum monthly wage in force on 1 January, €1,153 in 2026); not below zero

rows.label: Annual formula
rows.value: NPD = €8,964 − 0.49 × (annual income − 12 × the minimum monthly wage); not below zero

rows.label: Monthly employment income at which the NPD reaches zero (computed)
Monthly NPD, 0–25% participation level or severe disability
Monthly NPD, 30–55% participation level or moderate or mild disability
Child or dependant allowance
rows.value: None in 2026; from 2027 an additional NPD of €1,044 a year per child (GPM art. 20(11), version from 2027-01-01)

sections.basis: Deducted from employment income only; applied monthly at one employer on request, or in the annual return
sections.note: Non-residents get the NPD only in the annual return. The NPD does not apply to individual-activity or other non-employment income.

sections.note: Budget institutions and the Bank of Lithuania pay neither fund contribution. Each employer is assigned to one of four accident-rate groups.

sections.title: Contribution ceiling and average wage 2026

rows.label: Average wage (VDU) used for the 2026 contribution base
Annual ceiling for social insurance (VSD)
rows.value: 60 VDU: pay above it attracts a 0% rate

rows.label: Health insurance (PSD) ceiling for employees
rows.value: None: the ceiling excludes health insurance contributions

rows.label: Ceiling for the self-employed
rows.value: The previous year's 43 VDU, for VSD and PSD

rows.label: Refund of contributions above the ceiling
rows.value: Refunded to the employee by 31 May of the following year

rows.label: Minimum contribution base: the minimum monthly wage
rows.note: Pro rata to time worked; the employer pays both shares on any shortfall

sections.note: The same ceiling applies to employee and employer social insurance; once one insurance type reaches it, only the other types continue until they reach theirs.

sections.title: Second pillar pension accumulation (pensijų kaupimas)

rows.label: State contribution (share of the average gross wage of the year before last)
Participation
rows.value: Voluntary from 1 January 2026: automatic enrolment was repealed; anyone with insured income below pension age may join by contract with a pension company

rows.label: Suspension
rows.value: Contributions may be suspended for 12 months at a time, any number of times

rows.label: Extra contributions
rows.value: The participant may pay more, and the employer may also contribute

sections.note: Voluntary third pillar pension savings are separate and not covered here.
